abstract_html:
Acne-prone skin is commonly associated with increased sebum production, follicular obstruction, abnormal keratinization, and inflammation; effective cleansing is an indispensable part of topical skin care for oily and acneic conditions. Salicylic acid is widely celebrated in cosmetic dermatology for its lipophilic desmolytic and comedolytic mechanisms, whereas neem (Azadirachta indica) contributes well-documented botanical antimicrobial, antioxidant, and anti-inflammatory characteristics.

To investigate the laboratory feasibility of formulating a transparent gel face wash integrating salicylic acid (1% w/w) and freshly prepared aqueous neem extract, three laboratory batches (F1, F2, and F3) were prepared with sodium lauryl ether sulphate (SLES) systematically graded at 8%, 10%, and 12% w/w. The intermediate batch, F2 (10% SLES), was subjected to preliminary evaluation of appearance, optical clarity, fragrance, visible particulates, phase stability, homogeneity, spreadability, and subjective skin feel.

Batch F2 produced a uniform, pale-green transparent gel featuring a refreshing lime-like aroma without particulate precipitation or phase separation. Spreadability was qualitatively optimal with a balanced, subjectively moisturizing post-rinse sensory profile. Foam height reached 90 mm with a stable microgel network, verifying laboratory feasibility.

tab3_sub: Standardized laboratory procedure for fresh aqueous neem leaf extraction and stepwise gel compounding with Carbopol neutralization.
tab3_steps_grid_html:
1
Harvest & Selection

Fresh, healthy green neem leaves (Azadirachta indica) handpicked and inspected.

2
Surface Washing

Thorough washing with purified water to remove adhering dust, dirt, and foreign botanical contaminants.

3
Cellular Maceration

Mechanical crushing of leaves to maximize surface area contact for efficient aqueous solvent diffusion.

4
Thermal Aqueous Extraction

Soaked in distilled water and heated to boiling to dissolve hydrophilic bioactive limonoids and polyphenols.

5
Controlled Cooling

Extract allowed to equilibrate to room ambient temperature (25°C) to prevent thermal degradation.

6
Sterile Filtration

Filtration through fine filter paper to yield a crystal-clear, greenish bioactive neem aqueous filtrate.
